correctness.rationale: Every orbit has a directly enumerated exit-rate matrix; irreducibility ensures a unique stationary state. Exact 8-state stationary elimination gives the closed energy expression, matched independently against 32-state exact-rational stationary solves at several pairs of rational parameters. Differentiation factors into a strictly negative prefactor times a quartic with one coefficient sign variation for 2<w<6 and nonnegative coefficients for w>=6; Descartes rule and sign-at-boundary prove exactly one simple positive root or no positive root, respectively. Implicit differentiation and leading-order root balances give the two stated optimizer asymptotics. The standalone verifier passed 34 exact-rational checks; the infinite parameter claim is proved analytically.
